profile.headline: Software Developer at Tennessee Department of Finance and Administration
profile.summary:
With a background in media production and public administration, learning software development has been a natural extension and progression of those themes of creativity and problem-solving.  I enjoy being able to build a functional, interactive product that can tell a story through the data it produces.

Much of my professional career has been in public service, beginning as a case manager and later as an expert witness in administrative appeal hearings for SNAP, TANF, Child Support, and Medicaid. During that time, I earned a Master of Public Administration and sought to help replace legacy IT systems to improve efficiency for my agency as a Business Analyst. As a software developer, I carry the spirit of service, the drive for efficiency, and the joy of creativity into creating applications that provide value for the end user and API consumer.

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
Rosebay Studio was founded to create fun applications that intersect curiosity and entertainment using full-stack and mobile technologies:
- Android Studio
- Kotlin
- Java
- Google Cloud Functions
- RxJava 2
- Dagger 2
- Git/Github
- NodeJS
- JavaScript
- Babel
- Firebase
- Retrofit/OkHttp
- Google Custom Search Engine

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description: Member of a distributed team developing Android applications using third-party libraries such as RxJava, Dagger, and Retrofit, continuous integration with Jenkins, source code management with Git/Gitlab, and testing with Espresso, Mockito, and Jacoco.

positions.title: Apprentice Software Developer
positions.description:
Full-time, 6-month software development bootcamp. Students learn full stack software development with 3 months for front-end, and the final 3 months simulate a workplace environment utilizing scrum methodology.
- Created www.snaptest.help which correctly determines SNAP (Food Stamp Program) benefits for a majority of Tennesseans
- Cultivated understanding of OOP fundamentals through individual and collaborative efforts employing JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
- Practiced principles of code modularization, emphasized through use of technologies such as Handlebars
- Emphasized modern software development practices such as user stories, unit testing, test driven development, responsive and mobile-first design, and ES6 features
- Employed prominent JavaScript libraries and frameworks such as jQuery, Bootstrap, and AngularJS
- Created single-page applications using AngularJS routing and templating

positions.title: Content Producer
positions.description: Production of comedic video and photographic content.

positions.title: Program Coordinator, Appeals & Hearings Division
positions.description:
- Expert witness for administrative hearings for TANF, SNAP, Child Support, and Medicaid appeals
- Created evidence packets for appeals and provided testimony based on evidence and policies
- Compiled, categorized, and verified information from various systems and external sources to ensure accuracy of data and adherence to government rules and regulations
- Kept up-to-date on program and policy information to better serve clients and remain compliant with government regulations
- Evaluated documentation of services delivered
- Served as technical liaison to internal and external sources to adhere to policy and procedures
- Coordinated with other agencies, divisions, units, or departments to accomplish specific tasks or projects
- Answered questions from clients regarding program delivery

positions.title: Business Analyst, Child Support Division
positions.description:
- Identified electronic system or process defects for resolution
- Assisted in development of long-range objectives and strategies to achieve program goals and objectives
- Analyzed information and evaluated results to choose the best solution and solve problems
- Identified and evaluated problematic issues with other program staff for appropriate resolution
- Recommended and outlined changes to program policies to improve service and comply with government guidelines
- Evaluated the effectiveness of program delivery provided by human services staff to comply with government regulations
- Gathered information to determine the impact of service delivery proposals on agency priorities

positions.title: Eligibility Counselor II
positions.description:
- Interviewed clients and determined eligibility for monetary benefits for social services
- Remained up-to-date on new policies and procedures as they were implemented in order to ensure accurate eligibility determination
- Verified accuracy of information provided by customers during the interview process to ensure the customer received the benefits to which they were entitled
- Documented required verifications, services, benefits provided, and other case-related activity using a computerized case record and/or paper case files
- Interpreted policy and procedure guidelines in relation to the customer's circumstances to ensure their understanding
- Assessed the customers’ strengths and considers the customers’ goals and desired outcomes, work activities, and supportive services that would lead to self-sufficiency
- Identified benefits and services that might be available to customers both from the Department and from related outside sources to assist in meeting customer needs
